"""Run from the repository root; source qualification, not a detector trial."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import platform
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path.cwd()
sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT), str(ROOT / 'src')]
import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from tests.diagnostics.s11_boundary_temporal_probe import measure_pair, CHANNELS

OUT = ROOT / 'sample/output/s11-water-first-20261010-001'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(name, value):
    (OUT / name).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')

intake_path = ROOT / 'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-public-video-intake.json'
intake = json.loads(intake_path.read_text())
overview = next(v for v in intake['overview']['videos'] if 'water' in v['path'])
temporal = next(v for v in intake['temporal']['results'] if v['kind'] == 'water')
overview_frames = {f['frame_index']: f for f in overview['frames']}
temporal_frames = {f['frame_index']: f for f in temporal['frames']}
crop = temporal['display_crop_xyxy']
assert crop == [740, 250, 1160, 1080]
indices = [0, 205, 815, 822, 829, 1225, 1232, 1239, 1438, 1643]
groups = {'empty_context': [0, 205], 'inclined_context': [815, 822, 829],
          'bubbly_post_pour_context': [1225, 1232, 1239], 'later_surface_context': [1438, 1643]}
cases = []
pins = {
    'sample/sample5.mp4': overview['sha256'],
    str(intake_path.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(intake_path),
}
for name in [
    'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-public-video-rename.json',
    'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-public-water-surface-reply.json',
    'docs/60-evidence/s11/2026-10-10-local-truth-and-evaluation-audit.json',
    'tests/diagnostics/s11_boundary_temporal_probe.py',
    'src/oil_tracker/adapters/vision/temporal_raster_evidence.py',
]:
    pins[name] = sha(ROOT / name)
for n in indices:
    full = n in overview_frames
    f = overview_frames[n] if full else temporal_frames[n]
    pins[f['path']] = f['sha256']
    cases.append(dict(
        case_id=f'water-f{n:06d}', frame_index=n,
        nominal_time_sec=n / overview['fps'],
        group=next(k for k, v in groups.items() if n in v),
        source_raster=dict(path=f['path'], sha256=f['sha256'],
                           source_origin_xy=[0, 0] if full else crop[:2],
                           shape=[1080, 1920, 3] if full else [830, 420, 3]),
        human_role_scope=('Existing f822 qualitative surface reply only; no exact contour, '
                          'Foam absence, centre scalar or neighbour-frame propagation.'
                          if n == 822 else 'No new human role approval.'),
        scalar_truth=None, candidate_binding=None, partition='development',
    ))
for name, pin in pins.items():
    assert sha(ROOT / name) == pin, name
regions = {
    'upper_rim_context': [790, 320, 1120, 380],
    'upper_interior_context': [840, 390, 1070, 440],
    'surface_activity_context': [800, 450, 1115, 600],
    'patterned_base_context': [800, 780, 1110, 910],
}
preflight = dict(
    schema='s11-water-first-source-qualification-preflight-v1',
    base_head=subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
    script_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)), inputs=pins, cases=cases,
    source=dict(path='sample/sample5.mp4', sha256=overview['sha256'],
                width=1920, height=1080, fps=overview['fps'], frame_count=1644),
    geometry=dict(crop_xyxy=crop, source_origin_xy=crop[:2],
                  diagnostic_column_x=950, calibrated_glass_center=False,
                  recipe_created=False, numeric_truth=False,
                  effective_mask='whole saved native crop; no glare exclusion or physical visibility inference'),
    measurement=dict(
        owner='tests.diagnostics.s11_boundary_temporal_probe.measure_pair',
        reference_frame=0, compared_frames=indices[1:],
        channels=list(CHANNELS),
        operation='Existing four grayscale absolute-residual views; identity displacement/exposure, '
                  'exposure-only, translation-only, translation-and-exposure on identical registered common support.',
        regions=regions,
        region_scope='Illustrative context rectangles fixed from originals before residual measurement. '
                     'Neither masks, candidate bands, homogeneous material regions nor truth.',
        registration='Existing accepted numerical fit does not establish camera motion; preserve failures.',
        decision='NOT_EVALUATED', threshold=None,
        no_new_mechanism=True,
    ),
    review=dict(
        main_frames=[1232, 1438, 1643], neighbour_frames=[1225, 1232, 1239],
        focus_xyxy=[780, 440, 1130, 560], detail_xyxy=[840, 450, 1070, 540],
        display='Native clean context and 2x nearest-neighbour detail; no candidate contours or derived Y labels.',
        proposed_question='At 41.1 s, is the broad bright upper feature a water surface with ripples/bubbles, '
                          'or a distinct Foam layer with separate water/Foam and Foam/air roles? '
                          '47.98 and 54.82 s provide later context; indeterminate is a valid answer.',
        question_scope='New post-pour material-role ambiguity; not a repeat of the f822 inclined-surface question. '
                       'No exact pixel, tolerance or fixed-center product choice is requested.',
        answer_status='PENDING',
    ),
    boundaries=['No video decode, detector execution, tuning, label or Recipe rewrite.',
                'No physical role follows from brightness, residual or inferred frame state.',
                'No continuous 41-55 s annotation, accuracy/recall score or independent holdout.',
                'No mandatory empty-reference product feature or new evaluator.'],
)
save('preflight.json', preflight)
(OUT / 'run.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())

rasters = {}
for case in cases:
    f = case['source_raster']
    raw = cv2.imread(str(ROOT / f['path']), cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    assert raw is not None and list(raw.shape) == f['shape']
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = crop
    im = raw[y0:y1, x0:x1].copy() if f['source_origin_xy'] == [0, 0] else raw.copy()
    assert im.shape == (830, 420, 3)
    rasters[case['frame_index']] = im

gray = {n: cv2.cvtColor(im, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY) for n, im in rasters.items()}
mask = np.ones((830, 420), bool)
results = []
arrays_by_frame = {}
for n in indices[1:]:
    meta, arrays = measure_pair(gray[0], gray[n], mask)
    # A direct full-crop difference is a displayed source fact, not registration rescue.
    full_direct = cv2.absdiff(gray[0], gray[n])
    arrays['full_direct_uint8'] = full_direct
    region_rows = {}
    for name, box in regions.items():
        x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
        sy, sx = slice(y0-crop[1], y1-crop[1]), slice(x0-crop[0], x1-crop[0])
        common = arrays['valid'][sy, sx]
        region_rows[name] = dict(
            geometry_pixels=int(common.size), common_pixels=int(common.sum()),
            full_direct_mean_abs_gray=float(full_direct[sy, sx].mean()),
            full_direct_changed_pixels=int(np.count_nonzero(full_direct[sy, sx])),
            owner_mean_abs_gray={key: float(arrays[key][sy, sx][common].mean())
                                 if common.any() else None for key in CHANNELS},
        )
    name = f'f{n:06d}.npz'
    np.savez_compressed(OUT / name, **arrays)
    results.append(dict(frame_index=n, metadata=meta, regions=region_rows,
                        arrays=dict(path=str((OUT/name).relative_to(ROOT)), sha256=sha(OUT/name))))
    arrays_by_frame[n] = arrays
    print(f'f{n:06d}: {meta["status"]}; common={meta["common_pixels"]}', flush=True)

font_path = '/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf'
font = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, 23)
small = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, 18)
titlefont = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, 30)
bg, fg, muted = '#111820', '#eff4fa', '#b7c3d1'
def canvas(size, title, subtitle):
    im = Image.new('RGB', size, bg)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    draw.text((24, 18), title, font=titlefont, fill=fg)
    draw.text((24, 59), subtitle, font=small, fill=muted)
    return im, draw
def rgb(n):
    return Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(rasters[n], cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))
def detail(n, box):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
    return rgb(n).crop((x0-crop[0], y0-crop[1], x1-crop[0], y1-crop[1]))

sheet, draw = canvas((1468, 1250), 'Water: physical role review, before a detector trial',
                     'A = post-pour bubbly feature; B / C = later context. Clean pixels; no detector or truth overlay.')
for i, n in enumerate(preflight['review']['main_frames']):
    left = 24+i*480
    label = f'{"ABC"[i]}  f{n} / {n/overview["fps"]:.3f} s'
    draw.text((left, 97), label, font=font, fill=fg)
    sheet.paste(rgb(n), (left+20, 139))
    draw.text((left, 986), 'Centre detail (2x nearest-neighbour)', font=small, fill=muted)
    sheet.paste(detail(n, preflight['review']['detail_xyxy']).resize((460, 180), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (left, 1016))
draw.text((24, 1214), 'Detail = source X[840,1070), Y[450,540). Crop centre X950 is diagnostic, not calibrated Glass geometry.', font=small, fill=muted)
sheet.save(OUT/'water-role-review.png')

sheet, draw = canvas((2160, 432), 'The same post-pour context, 0.234 s apart',
                     'A broad bright feature has several visible outlines. No outlined pixel is assigned to Oil or Foam.')
for i, n in enumerate(preflight['review']['neighbour_frames']):
    left = 20+i*716
    draw.text((left, 103), f'f{n} / {n/overview["fps"]:.3f} s', font=font, fill=fg)
    im = detail(n, preflight['review']['focus_xyxy'])
    sheet.paste(im.resize((700, 240), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (left, 144))
draw.text((20, 400), 'Source X[780,1130), Y[440,560), 2x nearest-neighbour. Still frames do not establish a separate Foam layer or its lower boundary.', font=small, fill=muted)
sheet.save(OUT/'water-role-neighbours.png')

sheet, draw = canvas((1776, 1030), 'Empty-reference difference is an appearance measurement',
                     'All differences use f0. Fixed 4x display gain clips at 255; numerical readout uses original grayscale values.')
for i, (n, difference) in enumerate([(205, False), (205, True), (1643, False), (1643, True)]):
    left = 24+i*438
    draw.text((left, 103), f'f{n} ' + ('|I-I0| x4' if difference else 'original'), font=font, fill=fg)
    im = (Image.fromarray(np.minimum(arrays_by_frame[n]['full_direct_uint8'].astype(np.uint16)*4,255).astype(np.uint8)).convert('RGB')
          if difference else rgb(n))
    sheet.paste(im, (left, 147))
draw.text((24, 996), 'Difference is also present on fixed glass features. No subtraction mask, physical classification or threshold is adopted.', font=small, fill=muted)
sheet.save(OUT/'water-reference-difference.png')

for name, pin in pins.items():
    assert sha(ROOT/name) == pin, name
readout = dict(schema='s11-water-first-source-qualification-readout-v1',
               preflight_sha256=sha(OUT/'preflight.json'),
               runtime=dict(python=platform.python_version(), numpy=np.__version__, opencv=cv2.__version__),
               case_count=len(cases), pair_count=len(results), results=results,
               source_inputs_preserved=True, physical_decision='NOT_EVALUATED',
               figures={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(p) for p in sorted(OUT.glob('*.png'))})
save('readout.json', readout)
print('COMPLETE', OUT, flush=True)

"""Independently check the saved source qualification, without calling its runner."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT/'sample/output/s11-water-first-20261010-001'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
pre = json.loads((OUT/'preflight.json').read_text())
run = json.loads((OUT/'readout.json').read_text())
assert sha(OUT/'preflight.json') == run['preflight_sha256']
assert sha(OUT/'run.py') == pre['script_sha256']
for name, pin in pre['inputs'].items():
    assert sha(ROOT/name) == pin, name
for name, pin in run['figures'].items():
    assert sha(ROOT/name) == pin, name
assert len(pre['cases']) == len({c['frame_index'] for c in pre['cases']}) == 10
ox, oy, endx, endy = pre['geometry']['crop_xyxy']
images = {}
for case in pre['cases']:
    source = case['source_raster']
    im = cv2.imread(str(ROOT/source['path']))
    assert list(im.shape) == source['shape']
    sx, sy = source['source_origin_xy']
    im = im[oy-sy:endy-sy, ox-sx:endx-sx].copy()
    assert im.shape == (830, 420, 3)
    images[case['frame_index']] = im
assert {r['frame_index'] for r in run['results']} == set(images)-{0}
gray = {n: cv2.cvtColor(im, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY) for n, im in images.items()}
source_gray = gray[0].astype(np.float32)
pixel_values = 0
regions_verified = 0
channel_results = 0
unavailable = []
def close(a, b):
    assert np.allclose(a, b, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-5, equal_nan=True)
for r in run['results']:
    n = r['frame_index']
    assert sha(ROOT/r['arrays']['path']) == r['arrays']['sha256']
    with np.load(ROOT/r['arrays']['path'], allow_pickle=False) as archive:
        arrays = {k: archive[k] for k in archive.files}
    absolute = np.abs(gray[n].astype(np.int16)-gray[0].astype(np.int16)).astype(np.uint8)
    assert np.array_equal(absolute, arrays['full_direct_uint8'])
    pixel_values += absolute.size
    meta = r['metadata']
    if meta['status'] == 'registration_unavailable':
        unavailable.append(n)
        assert not arrays['valid'].any() and meta['common_pixels'] == 0
        assert any(meta[k]['status'] != 'accepted' for k in
                   ['registration_current_to_anchor', 'registration_anchor_to_current'])
        for key in pre['measurement']['channels']:
            assert np.isnan(arrays[key]).all()
    else:
        assert meta['status'] == 'measured'
        translation = meta['registration_current_to_anchor']
        assert translation['status'] == meta['registration_anchor_to_current']['status'] == 'accepted'
        transform = np.array([[1, 0, translation['raw_dx']], [0, 1, translation['raw_dy']]], np.float32)
        current = gray[n].astype(np.float32)
        warp = cv2.warpAffine(current, transform, (420, 830), flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,
                              borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)
        common = cv2.warpAffine(np.ones((830, 420), np.float32), transform, (420, 830),
                                flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR, borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT) == 1
        assert np.array_equal(common, arrays['valid']) and int(common.sum()) == meta['common_pixels']
        expected = {
            'direct': np.abs(source_gray-current),
            'exposure_only': np.abs(source_gray-(meta['exposure_only_gain']*current+meta['exposure_only_offset'])),
            'registered': np.abs(source_gray-warp),
            'registered_exposure': np.abs(source_gray-(meta['registered_gain']*warp+meta['registered_offset'])),
        }
        for key, value in expected.items():
            close(np.where(common, value, np.nan), arrays[key])
            close(float(value[common].mean()), meta['mean_absolute_residual'][key])
            pixel_values += value.size
            channel_results += 1
    for name, box in pre['measurement']['regions'].items():
        x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
        sl = (slice(y0-oy, y1-oy), slice(x0-ox, x1-ox))
        common = arrays['valid'][sl]
        recorded = r['regions'][name]
        assert common.size == recorded['geometry_pixels']
        assert int(common.sum()) == recorded['common_pixels']
        assert int(np.count_nonzero(absolute[sl])) == recorded['full_direct_changed_pixels']
        close(absolute[sl].mean(), recorded['full_direct_mean_abs_gray'])
        for key in pre['measurement']['channels']:
            if common.any():
                close(arrays[key][sl][common].mean(), recorded['owner_mean_abs_gray'][key])
            else:
                assert recorded['owner_mean_abs_gray'][key] is None
        regions_verified += 1
assert unavailable == [1438]

# Inspect the exact crops inside the figures, not just their file hashes.
sheet = np.asarray(Image.open(OUT/'water-role-review.png').convert('RGB'))
for i, n in enumerate(pre['review']['main_frames']):
    left = 24+i*480
    original = cv2.cvtColor(images[n], cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
    assert np.array_equal(sheet[139:969, left+20:left+440], original)
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = pre['review']['detail_xyxy']
    zoom = np.repeat(np.repeat(original[y0-oy:y1-oy, x0-ox:x1-ox], 2, axis=0), 2, axis=1)
    assert np.array_equal(sheet[1016:1196, left:left+460], zoom)
sheet = np.asarray(Image.open(OUT/'water-role-neighbours.png').convert('RGB'))
for i, n in enumerate(pre['review']['neighbour_frames']):
    left = 20+i*716
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = pre['review']['focus_xyxy']
    original = cv2.cvtColor(images[n], cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)[y0-oy:y1-oy, x0-ox:x1-ox]
    zoom = np.repeat(np.repeat(original, 2, axis=0), 2, axis=1)
    assert np.array_equal(sheet[144:384, left:left+700], zoom)
sheet = np.asarray(Image.open(OUT/'water-reference-difference.png').convert('RGB'))
for i, (n, difference) in enumerate([(205,False),(205,True),(1643,False),(1643,True)]):
    left = 24+i*438
    if difference:
        d = np.abs(gray[n].astype(np.int16)-gray[0].astype(np.int16))
        expected = np.repeat(np.minimum(d*4,255).astype(np.uint8)[:, :, None],3,axis=2)
    else:
